🎥🎬: Atlanta (2016–2022)

Earn Marks is a young father struggling to get his life together when he reconnects with his cousin Alfred, an aspiring rapper known as Paper Boi. When Alfred’s music starts gaining attention, Earn becomes his manager and tries to turn their growing success into a better life for himself and his daughter.

Alongside Alfred and their eccentric friend Darius, Earn navigates Atlanta’s unpredictable music scene, relationships, family problems, money, and the pressures of fame. As their journey continues, the series blends comedy, drama, and surreal moments to explore race, identity, ambition, and what success really means.
